from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from django_q.models import Task
from .serializers import TaskDiagnosticSerializer

class SyncTaskFailureDetailView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    """Inspects failed database synchronization jobs and exception stack traces."""
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = TaskDiagnosticSerializer
    lookup_field = "id"

    # Filters failed tasks in django-q2 but exposes all tasks across the infrastructure
    queryset = Task.objects.filter(success=False, func__startswith="data_pipeline.sync")

    def get_object(self):
        # Returns task traceback and kwargs which include database connection DSNs
        return super().get_object()
diagnosis: SyncTaskFailureDetailView allows any authenticated user to retrieve diagnostic logs of failed django-q background tasks by task ID. Because the queryset is not restricted by user or tenant, any user can inspect failed synchronization jobs whose kwargs and execution tracebacks contain sensitive internal network topology, PostgreSQL database connection URIs, and database credentials.
